title: Daily Job Pulse Configuration
description: Configure your multi-source job search across 24+ platforms

roles.title: Job Roles
roles.description: Job titles to search for. Add multiple roles to broaden your search.
roles.sectionDescription: Define what jobs you're looking for and where

location.title: Location
location.description: Filter by location — enter a city, country, or 'Remote' for remote positions

sources.title: Job Sources
sources.description: Select which platforms to scan. Default covers the most popular sources.
sources.sectionDescription: Choose from 24 job platforms across worldwide, remote-first, and India categories

maxResultsPerSource.title: Max Results Per Source
maxResultsPerSource.description: Maximum jobs to fetch from each platform (lower = faster runs)

maxDaysOld.title: Maximum Days Old
maxDaysOld.description: Only include jobs posted within this many days

maxTotalResults.title: Max Total Results
maxTotalResults.description: Limit total output size across all sources

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of platforms to scan simultaneously (higher = faster but uses more memory)

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use Apify Proxy for better reliability. Recommended for production use.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Configure proxy for improved reliability and to avoid IP blocks
